name: The Lich King's last stand
summary: At the Frozen Throne, the living confront the Lich King at the crown of his fortress. Tirion Fordring breaks free and brings Ashbringer against Frostmourne, shattering the cursed blade; the assault ends in Arthas's defeat. Shadowmourne is present because its bearer has reached the final challenge, but it is not the sole cause of victory. In the aftermath, a sealed chest is found beside the fallen king.
